Four small shopfronts face the lane: on the left a grocer with vegetable crates and seed packets under a lavender and cream striped awning, then a boutique with a pastel dress in its round window; on the right a small bright gym with a big window showing a yoga mat, then a fish and tackle shop with coloured floats and a coiled net by its door, no fish. A red cylindrical Singapore post box by a lamp post near the bottom. Potted flowers and one bench.
